---
title: "Theme & Word Cloud"
subtitle: "The theme cloud sizes each theme by how often it was coded; the word cloud shows raw vocabulary. Words are not codes, and codes are not themes."
---

```{=html}
<div id="tb-no-project-alert" class="alert alert-warning d-none">
<i class="bi bi-exclamation-triangle"></i> No active project selected. <a href="projects.html">Go to Projects</a> to create or open one.
</div>

<div id="tb-wf-content" class="d-none">

<div class="card tb-toolbar mb-4">
<div class="card-body">
<div class="tb-toolbar-group"><span class="tb-toolbar-label">Cloud of</span>
<div class="btn-group btn-group-sm tb-segmented" role="group" aria-label="Cloud type">
<input type="radio" class="btn-check" name="tbCloudMode" id="tb-cloud-mode-themes" value="themes" checked>
<label class="btn btn-outline-primary" for="tb-cloud-mode-themes"><i class="bi bi-diagram-3 me-1"></i>Themes</label>
<input type="radio" class="btn-check" name="tbCloudMode" id="tb-cloud-mode-words" value="words">
<label class="btn btn-outline-primary" for="tb-cloud-mode-words"><i class="bi bi-fonts me-1"></i>Words</label>
</div>
</div>

<div class="tb-toolbar-group" data-mode="themes"><span class="tb-toolbar-label">Level</span><div id="tb-tc-level"></div></div>
<div class="tb-toolbar-group" data-mode="themes" id="tb-tc-within-wrap"><span class="tb-toolbar-label">Within</span>
<select class="form-select form-select-sm" style="width:auto;max-width:18rem;" id="tb-tc-within" aria-label="Limit to one theme"></select>
</div>
<div class="tb-toolbar-group" data-mode="themes"><span class="tb-toolbar-label">Size by</span>
<select class="form-select form-select-sm" style="width:auto;" id="tb-tc-measure" aria-label="Size themes by">
<option value="frequency">Frequency (coded references)</option>
<option value="coverageCount">Respondents raising it</option>
<option value="totalWeight">Total weighted score</option>
</select>
</div>

<div class="tb-toolbar-group d-none" data-mode="words"><span class="tb-toolbar-label">Text</span>
<div class="btn-group btn-group-sm tb-segmented" role="group" aria-label="Text scope">
<input type="radio" class="btn-check" name="wfScope" id="tb-wf-scope-all" value="all" checked>
<label class="btn btn-outline-primary" for="tb-wf-scope-all">All transcript text</label>
<input type="radio" class="btn-check" name="wfScope" id="tb-wf-scope-coded" value="coded">
<label class="btn btn-outline-primary" for="tb-wf-scope-coded">Coded passages only</label>
</div>
</div>
<div class="tb-toolbar-group d-none" data-mode="words" id="tb-wf-theme-wrap"><span class="tb-toolbar-label">Under</span>
<select class="form-select form-select-sm" style="width:auto;max-width:18rem;" id="tb-wf-theme" aria-label="Limit coded passages to a theme"></select>
</div>
<div class="tb-toolbar-group d-none" data-mode="words"><span class="tb-toolbar-label">Ignore</span>
<input class="form-control form-control-sm" style="width:15rem;" id="tb-wf-stopwords" placeholder="extra stopwords, comma-separated" aria-label="Extra stopwords">
</div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="grid gap-4">
<div class="g-col-12">
<div class="card">
<div class="card-header tb-panel-header"><span id="tb-cloud-title">Theme cloud</span><button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-link p-0" id="tb-wf-cloud-png" title="Save as PNG"><i class="bi bi-camera"></i></button></div>
<div class="card-body tb-panel-body">
<div class="tb-cloud-box tall"><canvas id="tb-wf-cloud"></canvas></div>
<p class="small text-muted mb-0 mt-2" id="tb-cloud-note"></p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="g-col-12">
<div class="card">
<div class="card-header tb-panel-header"><span id="tb-table-title">Themes</span><button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary" id="tb-wf-export-btn"><i class="bi bi-download"></i> CSV</button></div>
<div class="card-body p-0">
<div class="table-responsive">
<table class="table table-sm table-hover align-middle mb-0">
<thead id="tb-wf-table-head"></thead>
<tbody id="tb-wf-table-body"></tbody>
</table>
</div>
<p class="small text-muted px-3 py-2 mb-0" id="tb-table-note"></p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>

</div>

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () { window.TB.whenReady(function () {
  var TB = window.TB;
  if (TB.seedDemoIfNeeded) TB.seedDemoIfNeeded();
  var project = TB.getActiveProject();
  if (!project) { document.getElementById("tb-no-project-alert").classList.remove("d-none"); return; }
  document.getElementById("tb-wf-content").classList.remove("d-none");

  function $(id) { return document.getElementById(id); }
  function esc(s) { return TB.escapeHtml(s); }
  var MEASURES = { frequency: "Frequency", coverageCount: "Respondents", totalWeight: "Total weight" };
  var WORD_ROWS = 60;
  var state = { mode: "themes", level: Math.min(1, Math.max(0, TB.maxThemeDepth(project))), within: "", measure: "frequency" };
  var lastThemes = [], lastWords = [];

  function renderWithin() {
    var options = TB.themesInTreeOrder(project).filter(function (t) { return TB.themeDepth(project, t.id) < state.level; });
    if (!options.some(function (t) { return t.id === state.within; })) state.within = "";
    $("tb-tc-within").innerHTML = '<option value="">All themes</option>' + options.map(function (t) {
      return '<option value="' + esc(t.id) + '"' + (t.id === state.within ? " selected" : "") + ">" + esc(TB.themePath(project, t.id)) + "</option>";
    }).join("");
    $("tb-tc-within-wrap").classList.toggle("d-none", state.mode !== "themes" || !options.length);
  }

  function renderThemeSelect() {
    $("tb-wf-theme").innerHTML = '<option value="">Any theme</option>' + TB.themesInTreeOrder(project).map(function (t) {
      return '<option value="' + esc(t.id) + '">' + esc(TB.themePath(project, t.id)) + "</option>";
    }).join("");
  }
  function toggleWordThemeSelect() {
    var coded = $("tb-wf-scope-coded").checked;
    $("tb-wf-theme-wrap").classList.toggle("d-none", state.mode !== "words" || !coded);
  }

  function renderThemes() {
    var items = TB.themeLevelItems(project, state.level, state.within || null);
    lastThemes = TB.sortThemeItems(items, state.measure, false);
    TB.charts.renderThemeCloud("tb-wf-cloud", items.map(function (i) {
      return { id: i.id, label: i.label, value: i.stats[state.measure], color: i.color };
    }), { onClick: function (item) { TB.ui.showThemeEvidence(project, item.id); } });
    $("tb-cloud-title").textContent = "Theme cloud";
    $("tb-cloud-note").textContent = "Each theme is sized by its " + MEASURES[state.measure].toLowerCase() +
      ", using its own colour. Click a theme to read the quotations behind it.";
    $("tb-table-title").textContent = "Themes by " + MEASURES[state.measure].toLowerCase();
    $("tb-wf-table-head").innerHTML = '<tr><th class="ps-3">Theme</th><th class="text-end">Frequency</th><th class="text-end">Respondents</th><th class="text-end pe-3">Total weight</th></tr>';
    $("tb-wf-table-body").innerHTML = lastThemes.length ? lastThemes.map(function (i) {
      var parent = i.path.indexOf(" › ") !== -1 ? i.path.slice(0, i.path.lastIndexOf(" › ")) : "";
      return '<tr role="button" data-theme-id="' + esc(i.id) + '"><td class="ps-3"><span class="d-inline-block rounded-circle me-2" style="width:.6rem;height:.6rem;background:' + esc(i.color) + '"></span>' +
        esc(i.theme.name) + (parent ? '<div class="small text-muted ms-3">' + esc(parent) + "</div>" : "") + "</td>" +
        '<td class="text-end">' + i.stats.frequency + "</td>" +
        '<td class="text-end">' + i.stats.coverageCount + "/" + i.stats.coverageTotal + "</td>" +
        '<td class="text-end pe-3">' + i.stats.totalWeight + "</td></tr>";
    }).join("") : '<tr><td colspan="4" class="text-muted ps-3">No themes yet.</td></tr>';
    $("tb-table-note").textContent = "";
    Array.prototype.forEach.call($("tb-wf-table-body").querySelectorAll("tr[data-theme-id]"), function (tr) {
      tr.addEventListener("click", function () { TB.ui.showThemeEvidence(project, tr.getAttribute("data-theme-id")); });
    });
  }

  function renderWords() {
    var scope = document.querySelector('input[name="wfScope"]:checked').value;
    var themeId = $("tb-wf-theme").value;
    var extra = $("tb-wf-stopwords").value.split(",").map(function (s) { return s.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
    lastWords = TB.wordFrequency(project, { scope: scope, themeIds: scope === "coded" && themeId ? [themeId] : null, extraStopwords: extra });
    TB.charts.renderWordCloud("tb-wf-cloud", lastWords);
    $("tb-cloud-title").textContent = "Word cloud";
    $("tb-cloud-note").textContent = "“Factory waste”, “dirty river” and “smoke” may all be coded Environmental Pollution, so a theme's frequency can be far higher than any single word's — use this as a vocabulary check, not a substitute for coding.";
    $("tb-table-title").textContent = "Word frequency";
    $("tb-wf-table-head").innerHTML = '<tr><th class="ps-3">Word</th><th class="text-end pe-3">Count</th></tr>';
    $("tb-wf-table-body").innerHTML = lastWords.length ? lastWords.slice(0, WORD_ROWS).map(function (w) {
      return '<tr><td class="ps-3">' + esc(w.word) + '</td><td class="text-end pe-3">' + w.count + "</td></tr>";
    }).join("") : '<tr><td colspan="2" class="text-muted ps-3">No words found for this scope.</td></tr>';
    $("tb-table-note").textContent = lastWords.length > WORD_ROWS
      ? "Showing the top " + WORD_ROWS + " of " + lastWords.length + " words — the CSV has them all." : "";
  }

  function render() { if (state.mode === "themes") renderThemes(); else renderWords(); }

  function setMode(mode) {
    state.mode = mode;
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll("[data-mode]"), function (el) {
      el.classList.toggle("d-none", el.getAttribute("data-mode") !== mode);
    });
    renderWithin();
    toggleWordThemeSelect();
    $("tb-tc-level").closest(".tb-toolbar-group").classList.toggle("d-none", mode !== "themes" || TB.levelOptions(project).length < 2);
    render();
  }

  state.level = TB.ui.levelControl($("tb-tc-level"), project, {
    name: "tbCloudLevel", value: state.level,
    onChange: function (v) { state.level = v; renderWithin(); render(); }
  });
  Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('input[name="tbCloudMode"]'), function (r) {
    r.addEventListener("change", function () { setMode(r.value); });
  });
  $("tb-tc-within").addEventListener("change", function (e) { state.within = e.target.value; render(); });
  $("tb-tc-measure").addEventListener("change", function (e) { state.measure = e.target.value; render(); });
  Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('input[name="wfScope"]'), function (r) {
    r.addEventListener("change", function () { toggleWordThemeSelect(); render(); });
  });
  $("tb-wf-theme").addEventListener("change", render);
  $("tb-wf-stopwords").addEventListener("change", render);

  $("tb-wf-export-btn").addEventListener("click", function () {
    var base = TB.exportUtil.slug(project.title);
    if (state.mode === "words") { TB.exportUtil.exportWordFrequencyCSV(lastWords, base + "-word-frequency"); return; }
    TB.exportUtil.downloadBlob(base + "-theme-cloud.csv", TB.exportUtil.toCSV(
      ["Theme", "Theme path", "Frequency", "Respondents Covered", "Coverage %", "Total Weighted Score"],
      lastThemes.map(function (i) { return [i.theme.name, i.path, i.stats.frequency, i.stats.coverageCount, i.stats.coveragePct, i.stats.totalWeight]; })
    ), "text/csv");
  });
  $("tb-wf-cloud-png").addEventListener("click", function () {
    TB.exportUtil.canvasToPNG("tb-wf-cloud", TB.exportUtil.slug(project.title) + "-" + (state.mode === "words" ? "word" : "theme") + "-cloud.png");
  });

  renderThemeSelect();
  setMode("themes");

  var resizeTimer = null;
  window.addEventListener("resize", function () { clearTimeout(resizeTimer); resizeTimer = setTimeout(render, 250); });
}); });
</script>
```
